programme.title: Michael Mossman
programme.sub-title: Munich Philharmonic Hall: Michel Camilo Quintet
programme.desc: Well-known for his exuberant style and intimate familiarity with a vast range of jazz and Latin idioms, Michel Camilo has always had a sixth sense for musical adventure. Camilo was one of the most stimulating jazz pianists to emerge in the mid- to late '80s. His powerful two-handed attack (full of impressive technical skills), his knowledge of both jazz and Afro-Cuban music, and his willingness to constantly take chances turn each of his solos into an adventure. This broadcast was taped during the 1991 Münchner Klaviersommer, when Camilo was playing with his amazing Quintet. He is accompanied by Ned Mann (bass), Cliff Almond (drums), Michel Mossman (trumpet and trombone) and Ralph Bowen (saxophone and flute). Camilo's rise to fame has been swift, and his influences range from jazz musicians like Art Tatum and Keith Jarrett to twentieth-century composers like Debussy and Ravel.

programme.title: Ted Curson
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: James Brown
programme.sub-title: James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. The "Godfather of Soul", "Mr. Dynamite", and "Soul Brother No. 1" was a major force in 20th century popular music, influencing many musicians in numerous genres.

programme.title: Trombone Shorty
programme.sub-title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty', pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: Clark Terry
programme.sub-title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague. Joining them is jazz legend Clark Terry on trumpet, flugelhorn and vocals in this exciting collaboration.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: I Wouldn't Give a Cripple Crab a Crutch
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively. Revel in Frank Sinatra's iconic version of “I've Got You Under My Skin". Immerse yourself in Dizzy Gillespie's dynamic performance of “Let Me Outta Here”, recorded live in Denmark in 1970. Enjoy Tony Bennett's unforgettable performance of “It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing)” at London's majestic Royal Albert Hall in 1974. Let the haunting beauty of Nat King Cole's 1957 performance of “Autumn Leaves” and Louis Armstrong's performance of “Basin Street Blues” from 1959 delight you. Dean Martin's smooth vocal stylings will enthrall you as he performs the jazz standard “Wrap Your Troubles In Dreams". Witness the electrifying energy of Sammy Davis Jr.'s performance of “Too Close For Comfort”. Join us for this unforgettable musical experience that you'll surely cherish!

programme.title: Paul Desmond, Dave Brubeck & Joe Morello
programme.sub-title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history. Captured at the pinnacle of their power and popularity, Paul Desmond (alto sax), Joe Morello (drums), Eugene Wright (bass) and Dave Brubeck (piano) explore the trails they blazed into the realm of odd time signatures with ‘Forty Days' and two versions of their groundbreaking hit ‘Take Five', as well as forays into world music with a unique exploration of ‘Koto Song'. Their intimate onstage chemistry and impeccable musicianship made the DBQ an award-winning jazz supergroup.

programme.title: Earl Hines
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Ryan Wiglesworth & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Ryan Wiglesworth conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of W. A. Mozart's Symphony No. 41 'Jupiter', K. 551. It is the longest and last symphony Mozart composed. It is the last of three symphonies Mozart composed during the summer of 1788. It follows the traditional symphonic form in four movements. Unlike Symphony No. 39, the work has no intro but instead a grand finale. Recorded at St. Luke's on November 11, 2020.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa & Maurizio Baglini
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni's Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong Liszt's Two Elegies for cello and piano Chopin's Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3 and Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein's iconic composition ‘Tonight' from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: John Legend
programme.desc: An artist with intellectual skills is John Legend, who studied English with a major in African American literature at the University of Pennsylvania. In college, he participated in a jazz group called Counterparts and at the time was introduced to singer Lauryn Hill, playing piano on the track 'Everything Is Everything' from the singer's first solo album. He finished college in 1999 and began composing his own songs Recorded two independent albums that were sold in their performances: 'John Stephens' (2000) and 'Live at Jimmy Uptown' (2001). He has performed on albums of singers like Alicia Key, Jay-Z and also made the album Wake Up! (2010) along with the American rap group, The Roots. His official discography includes Get Lifted (2004), Once Again (2006), Evolver (2008) and Love in the Future (2013). This presentation in London, 2014, at the Itunes Festival, manages to clean the career of this singer who besides being multitalented can be a human rights activist.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Michael Mossman
programme.sub-title: Munich Philharmonic Hall: Michel Camilo Quintet
programme.desc: Well-known for his exuberant style and intimate familiarity with a vast range of jazz and Latin idioms, Michel Camilo has always had a sixth sense for musical adventure. Camilo was one of the most stimulating jazz pianists to emerge in the mid- to late '80s. His powerful two-handed attack (full of impressive technical skills), his knowledge of both jazz and Afro-Cuban music, and his willingness to constantly take chances turn each of his solos into an adventure. This broadcast was taped during the 1991 Münchner Klaviersommer, when Camilo was playing with his amazing Quintet. He is accompanied by Ned Mann (bass), Cliff Almond (drums), Michel Mossman (trumpet and trombone) and Ralph Bowen (saxophone and flute). Camilo's rise to fame has been swift, and his influences range from jazz musicians like Art Tatum and Keith Jarrett to twentieth-century composers like Debussy and Ravel.

programme.title: Ted Curson
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: James Brown
programme.sub-title: James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. The "Godfather of Soul", "Mr. Dynamite", and "Soul Brother No. 1" was a major force in 20th century popular music, influencing many musicians in numerous genres.

programme.title: Trombone Shorty
programme.sub-title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty', pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: Clark Terry
programme.sub-title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague. Joining them is jazz legend Clark Terry on trumpet, flugelhorn and vocals in this exciting collaboration.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: I Wouldn't Give a Cripple Crab a Crutch
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively. Revel in Frank Sinatra's iconic version of “I've Got You Under My Skin". Immerse yourself in Dizzy Gillespie's dynamic performance of “Let Me Outta Here”, recorded live in Denmark in 1970. Enjoy Tony Bennett's unforgettable performance of “It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing)” at London's majestic Royal Albert Hall in 1974. Let the haunting beauty of Nat King Cole's 1957 performance of “Autumn Leaves” and Louis Armstrong's performance of “Basin Street Blues” from 1959 delight you. Dean Martin's smooth vocal stylings will enthrall you as he performs the jazz standard “Wrap Your Troubles In Dreams". Witness the electrifying energy of Sammy Davis Jr.'s performance of “Too Close For Comfort”. Join us for this unforgettable musical experience that you'll surely cherish!

programme.title: Paul Desmond, Dave Brubeck & Joe Morello
programme.sub-title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history. Captured at the pinnacle of their power and popularity, Paul Desmond (alto sax), Joe Morello (drums), Eugene Wright (bass) and Dave Brubeck (piano) explore the trails they blazed into the realm of odd time signatures with ‘Forty Days' and two versions of their groundbreaking hit ‘Take Five', as well as forays into world music with a unique exploration of ‘Koto Song'. Their intimate onstage chemistry and impeccable musicianship made the DBQ an award-winning jazz supergroup.

programme.title: Earl Hines
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Ryan Wiglesworth & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Ryan Wiglesworth conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of W. A. Mozart's Symphony No. 41 'Jupiter', K. 551. It is the longest and last symphony Mozart composed. It is the last of three symphonies Mozart composed during the summer of 1788. It follows the traditional symphonic form in four movements. Unlike Symphony No. 39, the work has no intro but instead a grand finale. Recorded at St. Luke's on November 11, 2020.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa & Maurizio Baglini
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni's Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong Liszt's Two Elegies for cello and piano Chopin's Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3 and Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein's iconic composition ‘Tonight' from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Carlos Santana
programme.desc: With a momentous career stretching back into the sixties, Santana has led the way in introducing initially Latin rhythms and styles and later influences from worldly cultures into the world of mainstream rock music. Along the way they have collected numerous awards, accrued multi-million album sales and garnered a string of top hit singles. Masterfully filmed in Montreux, Switzerland in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classic tracks from early hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" through to their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". This is undoubtedly the have-to-have definitive Santana live concert. Music video by Carlos Santana __© 2011 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: John Legend
programme.desc: An artist with intellectual skills is John Legend, who studied English with a major in African American literature at the University of Pennsylvania. In college, he participated in a jazz group called Counterparts and at the time was introduced to singer Lauryn Hill, playing piano on the track 'Everything Is Everything' from the singer's first solo album. He finished college in 1999 and began composing his own songs Recorded two independent albums that were sold in their performances: 'John Stephens' (2000) and 'Live at Jimmy Uptown' (2001). He has performed on albums of singers like Alicia Key, Jay-Z and also made the album Wake Up! (2010) along with the American rap group, The Roots. His official discography includes Get Lifted (2004), Once Again (2006), Evolver (2008) and Love in the Future (2013). This presentation in London, 2014, at the Itunes Festival, manages to clean the career of this singer who besides being multitalented can be a human rights activist.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.desc: Una madre celosa toma medidas para asegurar que su hija gane una beca de una academia de baile. Pero la progenitora de la víctima hará lo que sea necesario para proteger a su hija del malvado plan.

programme.title: Retrato de un Secuestro
programme.desc: Durante un día con su hija en un carnaval, una fotógrafo mira hacia otro lado por un momento y su hija desaparece. Esta madre arriesga todo, incluso su cordura para encontrar a su hija.

programme.title: La resurrección de los muertos
programme.desc: Una atípica película de muertos vivientes con fondo social y político, en la que se plantea qué pasaría si los fallecidos de los últimos diez años retornasen a la vida, y de cómo reaccionarían las autoridades y la población ante el hecho. La resurrección de los muertos –la mayoría de ellos de la tercera edad– influye en la vida de una placentera ciudad francesa que tendrá que volver a acogerlos como ciudadanos en pleno uso de sus derechos.

programme.title: Nadie sabe
programme.desc: Cuatro niños, hijos de distinto padre, viven felices con su madre en un pisito de Tokio, aunque nunca han ido al colegio. Un bu…

programme.title: El sureño
programme.desc: Sam Tucker, un esforzado jornalero del algodón que sueña con un futuro mejor para su familia, consigue tener su propia plantación, pero habrá de enfrentarse a un clima implacable, a una inesperada enfermedad y a la hostilidad de sus vecinos.

programme.title: El diablo, probablemente (V.O.S.E.)
programme.desc: Charles, un joven de veinte años (Antoine Monnier), aparece muerto en el cementerio parisino de Père-Lachaise. ¿Se trata de un suicidio o de un asesinato? Charles vive entre dos amores, Alberte (Tina Irissari) y Edwige (Laetitia Carcano). Inmerso en conversaciones existenciales con su amigo Michel (Henri de Maublanc), desprecia tanto “la felicidad de la tarjeta de crédito” como el compromiso político no se deja seducir ni por el anarquismo, ni por la militancia ecologista ni por las drogas. Una serie de encuentros casuales le llevan a descubrir en sí mismo el instinto de la autodestrucción.

programme.title: De latir, mi corazón se ha parado
programme.desc: Tom tiene 28 años y está destinado a seguir los pasos de su padre en el sórdido negocio inmobiliario. Sin embargo, gracias a un encuentro casual, concibe la ilusión de llegar a ser pianista como su madre. Con gran determinación, empieza a prepararse para una audición con una experta pianista china. Como ella no habla francés, la música será el único medio de comunicación entre ambos.

programme.title: Viaje a Italia
programme.desc: Steve Coogan y Rob Brydon reciben el encargo de un nuevo viaje gastronómico, esta vez por Italia. Estos dos improbables amigos conducen por todo el país mientras vuelven a discutir sobre la vida, el amor y el cine.

programme.title: El hombre del brazo de oro
programme.desc: Frankie Machine, un hombre con talento musical sale de la cárcel y, además, consigue dejar la heroína. Su principal problema será encontrar un medio de vida honrado y evitar las drogas y el juego.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: Super Papá Oso
programme.desc: El padre oso vive en la naturaleza con su hijo Xi Ha, pero cuando el cachorro es capturado por un criminal humano y vendido en el mercado negro, el padre oso se aventura en la gran ciudad para buscarlo.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Después de presenciar un accidente con un globo aerostático, un hombre comienza a recibir la atención obsesiva de otro testigo que cree compartir un vínculo especial con él. La situación evoluciona hacia una inquietante historia de paranoia.

programme.title: La gran enfermedad del amor
programme.desc: Kumail y Emily se enamoran, pero las diferencias culturales y la familia complican su relación.

programme.title: Bienvenido Señor Robuchon
programme.desc: Cocineros se reúnen en Marbella para ofrecer una cena en homenaje a su maestro: Robuchon.

programme.title: Nunca Es Tarde Para Enamorarse
programme.desc: Harvey, un hombre que acaba de quedarse sin trabajo, viaja a Londres para asistir a la boda de su hija.

programme.title: Aquel Septiembre
programme.desc: Septiembre la vida de Antonio se tambalea con el regreso de Carolina, su mejor amiga a la que no ve 6 años.

programme.title: Queen & Slim
programme.desc: Tras una ligera infracción de tráfico, un hombre (Daniel Kaluuya) y una mujer de color (Jodie Turner-Smith) que disfrutan de su primera cita, son parados por la policía.

programme.title: La Senda de los Forajidos: El Tesoro de Butch Cassidy
programme.desc: Roy, nieto del famoso ladrón de bancos Butch Cassidy, emprende una búsqueda del tesoro oculto por su abuelo.

programme.title: Petite Maman
programme.desc: Nelly tiene 8 años y acaba de perder a su abuela. Mientras ayuda a sus padres a vaciar la casa en la que su madre creció, explora el bosque que la rodea. Allí conoce a otra niña de su edad y surge una preciosa amistad. Entre juegos y confidencias, desvelarán un fascinante secreto.

programme.title: Más vale sola que mal acompañada
programme.desc: Tras abandonar a su marido, una mujer recorre los Estados Unidos con sus dos hijos buscando desesperadamente un hombre capaz de mantenerlos económicamente. Basada en las memorias del actor George Hamilton.

programme.title: La casa de los espíritus
programme.desc: >A mediados del siglo XX en Chile, Esteban logra salir de la pobreza y convertirse en el exitoso dueño de un negocio. Sus maneras estrictas y tradicionales se oponen a las de los jóvenes revolucionarios, entre los cuales se encuentra el joven Pedro, quien está enamorado de su hija.

programme.title: Bravetown
programme.desc: Josh es un alma sin rumbo con un talento musical extraordinario que se embarca en un viaje para encontrar lo que menos esperaba, pero que, sin duda alguna, más necesitaba.

programme.title: El hombre más buscado
programme.desc: Sobria película de espías a la vieja escuela llena de tensión y suspense. Un joven ruso sin papeles consigue llegar a la ciudad de Hamburgo. Lleva encima una sorprendente cantidad de dinero. Annabel, una abogada defensora de derechos civiles, intenta que no lo deporten.

programme.title: Un perro divino
programme.desc: Jake, un patriarca de familia, sufre un terrible accidente de coche en el que pierde a su esposa e hijos y tan sólo su perro Cooper y él consiguen salir con vida. Jake no es un amante de los animales y además está resentido con su perro ya que es el único superviviente de su mayor desgracia.

programme.title: Una sorpresa real
programme.desc: Cuando el novio de Riley la invita a Sudáfrica para conocer a su familia, ella se sorprende.

programme.title: Tiene Que Ser Amor
programme.desc: Durante las fiestas de Navidad, tres hermanas deciden viajar para para replantearse su vida amorosa.

programme.title: Todos los días
programme.desc: Este día no es muy diferente al resto de los días de Ned, sólo por algunos acontecimientos ocurridos.

programme.title: Una casa de locos
programme.desc: Un parisino de 27 años decide ir a Barcelona a estudiar el último año de la carrera de economía.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Un joven licenciado de origen humilde se convierte en secretario y persona de confianza de un acaudalado empresario, quien dirige su propia fábrica de acero. A medida que su relación laboral se estrecha, el joven deberá acudir al domicilio del empresario, donde conocerá a su preciosa joven mujer.

programme.title: Fallen Angels
programme.desc: Ming es un sicario que, cansado de correr riesgos, quiere dejarlo. Su agente, que ha roto el código profesional de evitar toda implicación personal, lo convence para hacer un último trabajo que no tendrá los resultados deseados.

programme.title: Por amor a Grace
programme.desc: Un apuesto bombero no ha vuelto a ser el mismo desde que murió su mujer. Sumido en una gran tristeza y apatía, acaba de ser suspendido temporalmente de su empleo por desobediencia. Esa misma noche se desata un devastador incendio en el piso de una joven a la que le salva la vida.

programme.title: Chungking Express
programme.desc: Dos historias de amor en un popular barrio turístico de Hong Kong. La primera describe el encuentro entre un joven policía y una misteriosa mujer fatal traficante de drogas. La segunda entre un solitario agente de policía y la joven camarera del bar donde aquél suele comer.

programme.title: Nueve vidas
programme.desc: El cineasta colombiano Rodrigo García vuelve a retratar el mundo femenino mostrando momentos especialmente cruciales y dramáticos en la vida de nueve mujeres, nueve vidas que son prisioneras de relaciones pasadas y presentes.

programme.title: La hermandad de la justicia
programme.desc: Tras una serie de ataques de bandas juveniles al instituto de Santa Lucia, el director del mismo, Bob Grootemat, anima a los estudiantes a que luchen para acabar con el clima de la violencia y drogas en el que viven. Inspirados por el discurso, un grupo de alumnos liderados por el joven Derek deciden formar una fraternidad secreta llamada “La hermandad de la justicia” dedicada a acabar con camellos, ladrones y todos aquellos que alteren la paz de las aulas.

programme.title: Kabei. Nuestra madre
programme.desc: Tokio, 1940. La familia Nogami vive feliz en una paz inusitada. Sin embargo, el patriarca es detenido y acusado de comunista. Su esposa Kayo se ve obligada a trabajar frenéticamente para poder dar de comer a sus dos hijas con el apoyo de Hisako, la hermana de su esposo. La Segunda Guerra Mundial arroja horribles y fatídicas noticias pero Kayo todavía guarda una última esperanza de que su marido regrese algún día.

programme.title: Gett, el divorcio de Viviane Amsalem
programme.desc: Viviane Amsalem, separada desde hace años de Elisha, su marido, quiere conseguir el divorcio para no convertirse en una margina…

programme.title: Los Dalton Contra Lucky Luke
programme.desc: Con el objetivo de robar un banco, dos ladrones roban un sombrero mágico que les hará invencibles.

programme.title: Doc West
programme.desc: Cuando Minnesota West salva al joven Silver, el chico lo lleva a Holysand, una ciudad al borde del caos.

programme.title: Juntos Para Vencer
programme.desc: Un adolescente acosado fantasea con ser el compañero de Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Buster el robo del siglo
programme.desc: Basada en la vida de Buster Edwards, un encantador padre de familia que atracó un tren correo de Glasgow.

programme.title: Tierra firme
programme.desc: Dos mujeres, Eva y Kat, y el mejor amigo de una de ellas, Roger. Un barco en los canales de Londres y una pregunta: ¿Es posible vivir el amor, la familia, y la vida de formas tan distintas y aún así permanecer unidos?

programme.title: Un padre de cuidado
programme.desc: Tim Allen es Joe, un chico cuya vida ha ido constantemente cambiando para peor. Cuando el acosador de la oficina va demasiado lejos, Joe decide que es hora volverse a sí mismo de un don nadie en un alguien.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: Entonces llegaste tú
programme.desc: Una viuda solitaria plantea realizar un viaje alrededor del mundo con las cenizas de su marido para visitar los sitios que ambos adoraban en sus películas favoritas.

programme.title: Jack Y Su Gemela
programme.desc: Jack Sadelstein (Adam Sandler) es un exitoso publicista de Los Angeles casado con una hermosa mujer (Katie Holmes) y con hijos, que odia un determinado acontecimiento anual: la visita de su hermana gemela, Jill (también Adam Sandler). A Jack le vuelve loco lo absorbente que es Jill y su personalidad pasiva-agresiva, que ponen patas arriba su vida. Las cosas se escapan todavía más de su control cuando Jill decide alargar su visita. ¡Parece que no se marchará nunca!

programme.title: Una Casa Patas Arriba
programme.desc: Una casa patas arriba es la continuación de la tronchante comedia familiar de 2005 de Revolution Studios, Are We There Yet?, y continúa donde terminó la primera. Ahora casado con Suzanne (Nia Long), Nick Persons (Ice Cube) se ha comprado una casa tranquila en las afueras para escapar de la locura de la gran ciudad, y para disfrutar de más espacio con su nueva mujer e hijos, Lindsey y Kevin (Aleisha Allen y Philip Daniel Bolden). Pero cuando su nueva casa requiere costosas reparaciones y él queda a merced de un excéntrico contratista (John C. McGinley), el sueño de Nick de vivir en una urbanización se convierte rápidamente en una desenfrenada pesadilla.

programme.title: Desmadre De Madres
programme.desc: Lo único que Allyson y sus amigas quieren es una cena pacífica con una charla de adultos...una largamente esperada noche de madres a solas.

programme.title: Solo Tu
programme.desc: Faith cree que el destino de su vida es unirse a un hombre llamado Damon Bradley. Años después, cuando está a punto de casarse con otra persona, tiene la oportunidad de encontrarse con el hombre que ella espera.

programme.title: Nos llaman Adiós Amigo
programme.desc: Los crímenes de un estafador se atribuyen a un vaquero de buen carácter y rápido con las pistolas que conoce y decide usar como señuelo.

programme.title: Más valientes que los hombres
programme.desc: Más valientes que los hombres - Una familia fronteriza cruza los Estados Unidos en caravana, con la esperanza de una vida mejor en el territorio de Oregón.

programme.title: La ley de la fuerza
programme.desc: Una colonia cuáquera trata de salvar a las gigantescas secuoyas de un barón maderero.

programme.title: The Warrant
programme.desc: Una orden de arresto lleva al alguacil John Breaker y al ayudante Bugle Bearclaw a cruzar el país para entregar a un criminal.

programme.title: El día más largo de Kansas City
programme.desc: En su 21.º cumpleaños, Apanatschi hereda la mina de oro secreta de su padre. Cuando unos codiciosos buscadores descubren su existencia, planean apoderarse de ella. Obligada a pedir ayuda a Winnetou, Apanatschi se ve envuelta en una peligrosa lucha por el tesoro, mientras una banda de forajidos también entra en escena.

programme.title: La Guarida del Lobo
programme.desc: Vicente ha sido herido y Toco lo acoge en su cabaña. El cambio en la pacífica relación que mantenían es provocado por un personaje que quiere las tierras de Toco. Pronto se desata el conflicto y se revelan secretos inesperados.

programme.title: Como te ves, me vi
programme.desc: La juventud rechaza los principios que les pretenden inculcar los adultos, quienes parecen haberse olvidado que practicaron los mismos excesos. A causa de esta incongruencia el comportamiento de los adolescentes es desmedido, frenético, a veces al punto de la tragedia.

programme.title: Bombal
programme.desc: La vida de María Luisa Bombal, una de las mujeres más importantes de la literatura latinoamericana.

programme.title: Mala fortuna
programme.desc: Ambientada en los años 50, "La Desgracia" cuenta la historia de Hugo Felice. Un oficinista depresivo, habitué de un bar de banquillo que alberga una fauna urbana plagada de suicidas, ex-convictos y perdedores. Es en este bar donde un detective privado interroga a Felice.

programme.title: Bienvenue à bord
programme.desc: Isabelle, directora de recursos humanos de una gran empresa de cruceros, ha cometido el error de ser la amante de su jefe. Sin embargo, cuando él decide poner fin a la relación, Isabelle se servirá del puesto que ocupa en la compañía para planear su venganza.

programme.title: Hijos de la medianoche
programme.desc: En la medianoche del 15 de agosto de 1947, el mismo día en que la India consiguió la independencia, Saleem y Shiva nacieron en el mismo hospital de Bombay y formaron parte de la primera generación libre del país. La historia de Saleem y Shiva, intercambiados en sus cunas al nacer, tiene como transfondo la convulsa historia de la India moderna, desde su independencia hasta los años ochenta: poderes sobrenaturales, amores prohibidos y secretos de familia se entremezclan con guerras y golpes de estado.

programme.title: Espiando a los detectives
programme.desc: Un cinéfilo aficionado al cine negro en extremo prueba de su propia medicina y ve cómo su vida da un vuelco de la mano de una extraña mujer fatal con una gran aventura en mente. A veces el amor supera a la ficción.

programme.title: Fly
programme.desc: Bex, una joven convicta, se une a un programa de rehabilitación social en la cárcel para lidiar con el doloroso trauma de su crimen. La dura líder del grupo, Ava, intenta encauzar a estos jóvenes por medio de una pasión común: el baile.

programme.title: Cuando los amos duermen
programme.desc: Samuel y Lourdes son un humilde matrimonio que se desvive cuidando los terrenos y la casa de su Señor. El dueño de la casa es Víctor, un vampiro ancestral que solo se alimenta de la sangre de gente malvada.

programme.title: Volvemos pronto con más contenido
programme.desc: ¡Estamos recuperando el sueño perdido! Permanece atento a la magnífica selección de entretenimiento de Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Alpha son tres jóvenes amigos criminales que se separaron en un momento determinado de su vida debido a un robo fallido. Ocho años después vuelven a estar juntos, cada uno eligiendo diferentes estilos de vida.

programme.title: Los días que vendrán
programme.desc: Vir (30) y Lluís (32) hace solo un año que salen juntos, cuando descubren que están “embarazados”. Durante 9 meses, seguiremos la aventura de esta joven pareja barcelonesa, el giro enorme que dará su vida, sus miedos, alegrías y las realidades que, durante su embarazo, crecen ante ellos.

programme.title: Mi gran despedida
programme.desc: Tres amores: el de Puri, dispuesta a hacer lo posible y lo imposible por dejar las cosas claras con su novio el de Milagro, que guarda más secretos de los que su naturaleza le permite, y el de Sara, cuya inminente boda reúne a un variopinto grupo de mujeres para festejar su compromiso.

programme.desc: A young group of avid documentary film makers are sent to shoot in the vast extremes of the South Australian wilderness. They end up in a place called Nowhere Else. What transpires there is devastatingly, like nothing else on Earth.

Pero de repente, su marido (Anthony Edwards, "ER") jura que nunca tuvieron un hijo y su psiquiatra (Gary Sinise, "C.S.I.: NY") insiste en que sufre delirios. Pero lo peor de todo es no hay ninguna evidencia para probar que Sam haya existido alguna vez. Obsesionada por los recuerdos de su hijo, la búsqueda por la verdad embarca a Telly en una oscura y devastadora conspiración de terror sobrenatural.
